fresh_uci.policy: Frozen before neural training. SHA256 order, one record per unused registrable-domain skeleton; 1000 per class. UCI original label 1=benign inverted explicitly. No predictions used.
fresh_uci.limitation: Historical same-source convenience sample, deliberately balanced; not live-web prevalence, external-source or temporal validation.

fresh_external.policy: Fixed hash sampling before predictions; max 10 official navigation paths per unused domain; one historical source-labelled phishing URL per unused domain. No outcome-based replacement.
fresh_external.limitations: Convenience technical-publisher benign pages and historical PhishTank labels, not a population-prevalence or forward-temporal test.

training_policy: All earlier inspected holdouts now development. Connected-group splits; fixed 8 CNN epochs, select by validation balanced accuracy. Official navigation rows weight 20. RF grid depth8/16 leaf2/5. Cascade uses validation only; prefer selection FPR<=.05 and recall>=.88, then balanced accuracy. Threshold0.5 fixed.
scope: Local academic demo, not population accuracy or production safety certification.
